title: Enūma Anu Enlil, Tablets 1–6 (lunar visibility omens) / «Энума Ану Энлиль», таблицы 1–6
author: Babylonian/Assyrian celestial diviners (canonical series)
date: Compiled late 2nd–early 1st mill. BCE; Nineveh manuscripts 7th c. BCE
size: 6 tablets, est. several hundred omens (~1,000 lines)
edition: Verderame, Le tavole I–VI della serie astrologica Enūma Anu Enlil (2002, Italian); Virolleaud, L'Astrologie chaldéenne (1905–12, public-domain copies).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Энума Ану Энлиль' cites no translation (only a pop-science book); none found elsewhere.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia: Tablets 1–6 are edited only in Italian (Verderame 2002); 'less than half of the series' is in English.
value: Foundation of Babylonian celestial divination and the root of Hellenistic astrology (Greek lunar omens, Hephaestion, John Lydus). Key for classicists studying 'Chaldaean' science.
ai_feasibility: high: rigidly formulaic protasis/apodosis with conventional logograms. Technical terms and broken entries need expert verification.
